issues.description: The package contains code and CID/GVKEY identifier or test lists, but not the full analysis inputs. The source-specific products, author-prepared panels, fields, versions and historical populations in the data requirements remain unresolved; no current access barrier is established.

The Perl stages concatenate some output directory names to filenames and nest later-stage outputs under the current input directory. SAS and Stata also use inconsistent tilde and $draft3 paths, and 2main.do has no explicit project working directory or draft3 global. These are resolvable working-copy path and orchestration setup tasks; the separate missing dic.txt and conference_header inputs and generated-file schema handoffs remain unresolved under I0003.

Appendix A3 documents the Exhibit 10 selection and manual-review producer for the supplier-contract sample, so R0019 has a documented manual route as an alternative to the author-prepared panel. The final panel’s field/key/coding/coverage contract remains unresolved. Other consumers lack supplied producers or output contracts, including import_penetrate, sic_from_segment, cartel_convict, cartels by industry, hhi_census, conference_header and dic.txt; the Stata consumer and SAS producer schemas for generated files also require reconciliation.

The TNIC block keeps gvkey/year/similar, then drops duplicates by gvkey/fyear before merging on gvkey/year. The retained and deduplication keys conflict. The supported working-copy correction is to deduplicate on gvkey/year.

The PPI crosswalk merge uses nogen, and the later unconditional drop _merge can fail if that variable is absent. A guarded capture drop preserves the cleanup when _merge exists and is a no-op when it does not.

The supplied code calls hhi sale, renames hhi_sale to hh_index, and later requests hhi_ in a winsor2 varlist. The hhi command output contract and variable state are not established; verify the actual producer output and Stata abbreviation behavior before proposing a variable edit.

The supplied SAS stockreturn output defines BHAR and BHAR_sizeadj, while 2main.do refers to bhar_size. Stata variable names are case-sensitive: a lower-case bhar_size abbreviation could match only an actual lower-case bhar_sizeadj field, subject to varabbrev and uniqueness. Verify the actual export/import spelling and abbreviation setting before treating this as a mismatch.

evidence.description: The datasheet specifies the Thomson Reuters transcript period, XML structure, manager presentation text and product-market word measure.
evidence.quote:
Conference Calls: We obtain our sample of quarterly earnings conference call transcripts
over the 2002 to 2012 period from Thomson Reuters. We most recently collected data
from this source on October 2017. The transcripts are in XML format. We parse the date
of the call, firm identifiers and the types of conference calls from XML-friendly headers.
We then link the earnings conference call transcripts with Compustat based on the firm
identifiers. The transcripts also provide tags to identify different segments of the call (e.g.,
presentation and discussion) and individuals. We parse the text of presentation by
managers using a Perl script and calculate the proportion of product-market-related
related words in each call.

evidence.description: Appendix A3 specifies Exhibit 10 filing selection, automatic word filters, manual exclusions, filer-as-supplier screening and the 2000–2012 contract period.
evidence.quote:
We first obtain the URL address of annual, quarterly and current reports filed by non-
financial firms incorporated in the U.S. from WRDS, then download all material business
contracts filed as Exhibit 10 through the 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K. As we are interested in supply
contracts only, we require the contract’s title to include at least one word from the following
list: sell, sale, order, procurement, supply, supplier, purchase, purchaser.
   If the title is not specified in the form of < T IT LE > “T itle00 < /T IT LE >, we require
the contract to 1) have a word from the word list of sell, sale, order, procurement, supply,
supplier, purchase, purchaser in conjunction with a word in the same sentence from the word
list of agreement, agrmt, agree, agmt, form, plan, contract, letter, confirmation, commitment,
order, NO; 2) have a word from the word list of seller, purchaser, buyer, subscriber, producer,
carrier, supplier, customer, consumer, manufacturer.
   Meanwhile, we exclude a contract automatically if in the first 200 words it contains a word
from the list of interest, registration, receivable, acquisition, merge, real estate, patent, lease,
compensation plan, real property, property, properties, bonus, financing, equity, loan, debt,
lend, borrow, debenture, incentive plan, executive, stock, security, securities, bond, option,
employee, asset, note, land, credit, warrant, residual, rent, share, bank, dollar, employ. This
word list is developed based on our manual reading of 500 business contracts. This results
in 6,671 contracts from 4,007 unique firm-years over 2000 to 2012.
